svg.title: ELLIOT, voice companion for Android
svg.desc: A 3D particle orb, the ELLIOT Holo Core, turns above a hologram projector in deep space. The ELLIOT wordmark shimmers with an aurora gradient beside the tagline: Say Hey Elliot. Ask about your phone. Hear the answer.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Say “Hey Elliot”. Ask about your phone.
